thread:
ania: Kicking off a proposal to prune low-value microservices and centralize stable adapters into a platform package. Timeline: 2-3 quarters. RFC follow-up incoming.
sam: Agree. Need objective filters so we don't just pick easy wins.
mike: Use call-graph + deploy frequency to find safe candidates.
lee: Draft filters:
```
- avg QPS < 1 (30d)
- deploys <= 1 per 30d
- single owning team
- <3 alerts in 90d
- not on model-serving hotpath
```
ania: infra-bot, run scan with those heuristics.
infra-bot: scan done: 39 candidates (sample: enrich-legacy-3, sidecar-lite, auth-shim-old)
sam: Attach callers and deploy history plz.
infra-bot: attached: callers.csv, deploys.csv
mike: Migration patterns: merge-to-platform, extract-shared, archive. Pilot first.
lee: Safety: feature-flag + per-tenant rollout + canary + tracing tag `X-merged-from`.
ania: Spike plan: 2-week audit, then pilot two services (one merge, one extract) over ~6 weeks.
sarah: I'll lead auth-shim-old extraction; need secret migration plan and tenant semantics preserved.
mike: Pilot SLIs: p95 latency, p99 cold-start, 5xx rate, per-tenant success. Also measure cost delta.
lee: Automate rollback test in CI: `make rollback-test` and include in canary pipeline.
ania: I'll post RFC follow-up tomorrow with full candidate sheet, infra outputs, impact calc, and playbook.
sam: Happy to review the RFC. :+1:
mike: I'll join the spike. :rocket:
ania: Action items captured: infra scan, manual vetting, pilot merges, SLI dashboards, cost measurement. We'll triage in next arch sync.
